newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: LG Semicon develops new chip technology.
newsitem.headline: LG Semicon develops new chip technology.

text.p: South Korean chipmaker LG Semicon Co, a unit of the LG Group, said on Tuesday it had developed a 0.35-micron-fine technology for manufacturing application-specific integrated circuit (ASIC) chips.
LG said in a statement that chips made through the new process would feature a data processing speed about 35 percent faster than those made with conventional 0.5-micron-fine technology.
It said the new process would also reduce the size and power consumption of the custom chips, which are used only for specific purposes.
